entities.name: Nadeen Dormet
entities.description: A stone dwarf of Dominaria who with her tribe destroyed the Stronghold.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Investigated Bluefire Mountain and made a pact with Nadeen.

entities.name: Bluefire Mountain
entities.description: Mountain where Nadeen's band was at work.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Phyrexian stronghold within a volcano, destroyed by Nadeen's tribe.

entities.name: Stone dwarves
entities.description: Dwarves who turn into formless piles of stone.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: War of which the Battle of the Stronghold was one of the last stages.

entities.name: Battle of the Stronghold
entities.description: One of the last stages of the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Home plane of the stone dwarves.

events.summary: Eladamri, Sivvi and Grizzlegom find Nadeen's band blasting at Bluefire Mountain.
events.quote: They investigated and found Nadeen and her band of stone dwarves at work.

events.summary: Nadeen and Eladamri's group form a pact to assault the Stronghold from different angles.
events.quote: they formed a pact to assault the Stronghold, each from their angle

events.summary: Nadeen and her tribe cause a massive eruption that destroys the Stronghold.
events.quote: Because of her tribe's actions, the Stronghold was destroyed.

events.summary: Nadeen survives a direct attack from Yawgmoth and attends the Heroes' Memorial.
events.quote: Nadeen survived the Apocalypse and even a direct attack from Yawgmoth himself
